item.text: {"claim_id":"C051","obligation_id":"C051-B-1","contract":"LIMIT_WARRANT","subject":"Four weeks of trial follow-up cannot establish an eight-week repeat-purchase effect for new trial entrants.","verdict":"SATISFIED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"The target outcome spans eight weeks, while the proposed trial provides only four weeks of follow-up for new entrants. Later purchases remain unobserved, so those observations alone cannot establish the full eight-week effect. Extrapolation would require additional assumptions or evidence. This limitation follows from the observation window, without assuming the proposed trial occurred.","packet_id":"H7-T03-2","evidence_used":[{"source_id":"T001"},{"source_id":"P017"}]}
